features: IMOU Cruiser SE+ 4MP outdoor Wi-Fi pan/tilt

frigate.notes: IMOU uses the Dahua protocol; the RTSP path follows the Dahua realmonitor convention but is not independently verified on this specific SKU.

home_assistant.notes: IMOU uses the Dahua protocol; the ONVIF integration works.

blue_iris.notes: Select the 'Dahua' profile — IMOU uses the Dahua protocol.

release_notes: Cruiser SE+ 4MP (IPC-S41FEP). Corrected from a wrong 'bullet' form factor (it is a 355/0-90 pan/tilt) and a wrong 'PoE' claim (it is DC 12V + Wi-Fi/LAN). Corrected 2026-10-30 against the official Imou spec sheet: audio mic/speaker/two-way false -> true; features "4MP PoE outdoor color bullet" and "IP67" -> 4MP Wi-Fi pan/tilt and IP66; lens 3.6 -> 3.6 or 6 mm with the 6 mm FOV 48 H / 28 V / 56 D added; added H.265 up to 25 fps and the 110 dB siren (source: the 4MP block of the en spec page, which is mislabelled "Cruiser SE+ 5MP"; the current 3MP/5MP SE+ datasheets are a different generation, IPC-K7C).
